commenti.body:
My bathroom walls are a bit empty so I was thinking of hanging up some shots of famous bathroom movie scenes. What comes to mind, apart from the classics Trainspotting, The shining, Psycho?   
   

   
Also, where would you go to find HD images? I only know about film-grab.com but quality is not great.   
  

  
Thanks!

Few that spring to mind would the The Good The Bad And the Ugly, Cool Runnings, Dumb and Dumber, Pretty Woman, Pillow Talk. Or you could use the bathtub scene from Birth if you really wanted to weird people out.

I believe Shot Deck is often used by people in the industry when they want screenshots for creating mood boards etc. not used it myself though.
The Other Side of The Wind has some great bathroom scenes
*Full Metal Jacket* has a quite disturbing bathroom scene.

Belle de Jour (1967): My 14th Bunuel film (The Discreet Charm of the Bourgeoisie (1972) and The Phantom of Liberty (1974) are the big ones that remain) and so far comfortably my favorite. What a distressing masterpiece, like Repulsion by way of Vertigo.
The Big Lebowski has a couple.

> (The Discreet Charm of the Bourgeoisie (1972) and The Phantom of Liberty (1974) are the big ones that remain)

Those two are my favourites.

I finished my quest of seeing every Buñuel picture in 2020. All 30+ of them. Feels a bit sad that there aren't any more to look forward to, but I guess I'll be rewatching most of them somewhere down the line.

Just saw Cinema Paradiso , but didn't get why is it considered so great. It's a bit too long with the stuff about the movies being shown after the fire. Then I found the love story between Elena and Toto to be a bit under cooked

Did hit me in the feels in the start and towards the end because of Alfredo.
One of the favorites of Tarantino and Edgar Wright.
